random_baseline_note: Uniform random assertion over 4 labels ≈25% on eligible atoms; always-NOT_MENTIONED yields 0% coverage. Native 81% assertion on covered atoms is well above chance.

interpretation.summary: Native100 evidence_bottleneck shows real P1 signal (not random): 56% coverage with 81% assertion accuracy on covered atoms and 100% exact gold span when committed. Tradeoff vs frontier students: -22pp coverage, +13pp assertion on covered atoms, far higher span precision on eligible atoms. Conservative scorer — abstains more but is accurate when it commits.
interpretation.vs_student_gap: Student-A still leads on deployment coverage (78% vs 56%). Native leads assertion on covered atoms (81% vs 68%). QLoRA student lane remains higher ROI for closing coverage gap.
interpretation.caveat: Native exact_gold_span rate uses eligible=84 (covered asserted atoms only); reference rates use full screening denominator — not directly comparable as headline rates.
